camera.description: The policy-visible RGB-D camera whose published depth and calibration bind this query. Pixels and rectangles are in this camera's own top-left OpenCV frame at its published resolution; world coordinates are metres in the world frame.

world_points_m.description: One to sixteen world-frame points to project into this camera's image. Send this to find out where a coordinate you already hold appears in the view. Exactly one of world_points_m, points or region may be sent; window_px does not apply to this operation.

items.description: One world-frame point as [x,y,z] in metres.

points.description: One to sixteen source pixels to back-project to world points, without persisting a mark or returning an image. Exactly one of world_points_m, points or region may be sent.

items.description: One pixel as [u,v] in integer pixels of this camera's image, top-left OpenCV origin: u from the left edge, v from the top.
Non-negative pixel coordinate inside this camera's published width and height.

region.description: One source-image rectangle [x0,y0,x1,y1] in integer pixels, top-left OpenCV origin, with x0<x1 and y0<y1 and the whole rectangle inside the image, summarised over its valid depth. Exactly one of world_points_m, points or region may be sent; window_px does not apply to this operation.

items.description: Rectangle edge in pixels of this camera's image.

window_px.description: Half-width in pixels of the square depth window whose median is taken when back-projecting each entry of points; 0 reads the single pixel. Default 3. Ignored by world_points_m and region.

step.description: Saved policy-state step to read. Omit or send null for the current observation; a saved step answers from the artifacts published at that step, not from the world as it is now.

camera.description: Public RGB-D camera name; all points refer to this one view.

points_uv.description: Independent positive point queries on one image. Prefer 3–5 separated interior points; these points are not a joint prompt for one mask.

items.description: One independent positive point [u,v], in integer source-image pixels; OpenCV top-left coordinates.

max_candidates.description: Per-point mask budget: at most this many distinct masks for each queried point separately, an integer 1-3, default 3. It is not a total across the call. Every point's leading mask is admitted before any point's second, so this bounds how many alternatives one point may keep, never which points get an answer. A call delivers at most 12 distinct masks and 5 enlarged crops overall, and each point reports what it lost to its own budget and to that shared cap separately.

step.description: Optional saved observation step in the current round. Omit or null for the current image; historical targets remain historical.

camera.description: Exact current native-resolution RGB-D camera in which to ground the text.

max_candidates.description: Maximum ranked regions to return, 1 to 3, default 3. Three is what the grounding service answers per call, so a larger number is refused before the request is sent rather than returned as an error you cannot act on. Close-up previews are capped at the first six across a step: the request window holds 24 images and refuses rather than dropping the oldest. Fewer regions answer faster: three cost roughly 479 milliseconds against 244 for one.

text.description: Short visible object or part description used to retrieve an inspectable candidate set; use task language or a concrete visual rephrasing, never a simulator identifier.

max_candidates.description: Maximum alternatives to inspect from this one query, from one through three, default 3. This truncates a call-local ranking and does not select a grasp or request repeated planning.

target_ref.description: Exactly one target_ref returned by vision_ground or vision_segment for the current immutable observation; do not copy an older reference after the world or observation changes.
